names: THE MOON-月がほしいと王女さまが泣いた
The King's Daughter Cries for the Moon

synopsis.text: The story centers on a princess who wishes to reach the Moon. Her journey and resulting disappearance raise clamor and chaos throughout the royal palace and among the creatures of the kingdom.
